cloudOff.name: folders
cloudOff.description: The folders directly inside one folder on the person's own computer, or on a box they added, one level at a time, as the app's import dialog browses them: each folder's absolute path, whether git tracks it, and how many hidden ones the level holds. Browse this to name a folder for import instead of guessing a path. The roots are that computer's home folder and the folder of every project on it; a path outside those is refused, and folder absent lists the home folder. Folders only: no file is named and nothing is read.

folder.description: the folder to list, absolute and inside the roots; absent lists the home folder

hidden.description: true lists the hidden folders too, which are otherwise only counted

repos.description: true answers every git repo under the home folder and the recorded projects instead of one level, each with its branch and when git last wrote to it, most recent first; folder is ignored

on.description: the computer whose folders to list, by the name computers lists; absent is the computer the app runs on
